approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: Via the Lady of the Lake ferry from Chelan to Stehekin, then the NPS shuttle ~11 miles to High Bridge

pins.name: High Bridge (Stehekin Valley Road)
pins.directions: There is no road to Stehekin. Take the Lady of the Lake ferry up Lake Chelan from Chelan to Stehekin, then ride the park shuttle about 11 miles up the Stehekin Valley Road to High Bridge, where the Pacific Crest Trail heads up Agnes Creek.

pins.name: Middle Gunsight summit
pins.directions: Follow the Pacific Crest Trail and Agnes Creek trail about 9 to 10 miles, cross Agnes Creek on a log, and bushwhack steeply about 5,000 ft into the upper Blue Glacier basin to a high camp on the rock ridge above the glacier, below the east side of the Gunsight peaks. From camp, work around to the west side of the towers and climb the Southwest Ridge to the summit.
